text: Agent Guard 是面向 DSH 的插件，为 Bash 删除类操作提供执行前检查，并把共享 Python Core 的判决接入 DSH 的工具前置事件。它注册安全删除、恢复和状态查询三个模型工具，也可向系统提示加入操作指引。主要能力包括：为支持的删除操作保留可恢复数据、为部分 Git 覆盖操作保存快照、列出和恢复隔离事务，以及查看适配器状态与清理信息；还提供需显式启用的文本读取结果脱敏扩展。适合希望在 DSH 工作区中管理删除和恢复流程的编码 Agent 使用。运行 Core 需要 Python 3.9+ 与 Git；可选读取扩展需要显式配置本地 DSH 包路径和工作区。

Agent Guard connects DSH's pre-execution event to a Python Core for supported Bash deletion checks. It adds tools to delete, restore transactions and view status, plus prompt guidance. An optional extension scans native text-read results. The Core needs Python 3.9+ and Git.
想让 DSH 删除文件前先经过恢复流程。
有没有办法在 DSH 里查看并恢复之前隔离的删除事务？
我希望模型能用一个工具安全地删除工作区里的路径或通配符。
让 DSH 在执行部分 Bash 删除命令之前做检查并给出处理结果。
需要查询恢复区占用情况和适配器诊断时，有什么 DSH 工具可用？
I want DSH to check supported deletion commands before Bash runs them.
Can I list a recovery transaction and restore its files from a DSH tool?
I need a DSH tool that reports adapter state and recovery storage usage.
Agent Guard 功能「安全删除」：调用 agent_guard_safe_delete 并传入路径或 glob，获得共享删除工具返回的 JSON 报告。
Agent Guard 功能「命令前检查」：支持的 Bash 删除命令在 tools/pre-execute 中检查，并继续、询问或拒绝。
Agent Guard 功能「恢复事务」：调用 agent_guard_restore 可列出隔离事务，或按 txid 请求恢复。
Agent Guard 功能「状态查询」：agent_guard_status 显示适配器诊断、恢复模式、占用量和清理命令。

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · AGENT-GUARD：Agent Guard preserves recovery data before supported destructive actions,
checks text before sending it, and provides a Lab for testing agent and host
behaviour. The shared Python Core can be called through command-line tools
or host adapters.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · AGENT-GUARD：**AI agents setting up this project:** Before changing configuration or writing
a bridge, read the [integration requirements](adapters/INTEGRATION.md), then
the [setup workflow](docs/guides/getting-started.md#set-up-a-coding-agent) and
the matching adapter guide. Check your actual host/version and its official
hook documentation, verify the integration, and report the observed coverage.
Installed Skills or copied configuration alone do not establish protection.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · AGENT-GUARD：We currently focus on **DSH and Kimi Code** integrations. For other hosts,
ask the official coding agent to configure Agent Guard locally.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · AGENT-GUARD：A Skill supplies instructions; it does not intercept tool calls. Automatic
protection depends on an active, compatible host hook and its covered tools.
The optional local MCP adapter provides explicit tools and does not intercept
actions that bypass them; its SDK installation is separate from the Core.
Agent Guard is not an OS sandbox against a malicious process with equal
privileges. The [capability matrix](docs/guides/harness-capabilities.md)
states the observed coverage and gaps.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · guard-lab: test with evidence：guard-lab is a **user-controlled experiment tool**. It puts non-secret,
synthetic markers and harmless bait into a disposable project and observes
only declared channels. The real controller and evidence stay outside the
fixture given to the tested agent.

Its workflow separates three questions:

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · guard-lab: test with evidence：1. **Calibrate:** do the observer, markers, scans and evidence chain work?
   Built-in controls call no model and make no external-network request.
2. **Observe exposure:** does an unguarded real-harness trial trigger the
   selected channel?
3. **Compare protection:** after an effective baseline, does a matched
   guarded trial reduce or block that exposure?

Start with one zero-model control from the package or checkout root:

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · guard-lab: test with evidence：```sh
lab_run="$(mktemp -d)"
python3 guard_lab.py run --case clean --output-dir "$lab_run/clean" --json
```

The other controls are `mock-positive`, `mock-injection` and
`snapshot-positive`. Run all four before a real-harness experiment, following
the [Lab guide](docs/lab/guard-lab.md). Installed packages also expose
`agent-guard-lab`.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · guard-lab: test with evidence：A control PASS means **instrument calibration**, not model safety.
An unhealthy observer or missing evidence is `INCONCLUSIVE`; a quiet
guard-off baseline cannot establish mitigation. Matched comparisons require
the same relevant harness/version/model, task, protocol and non-guard
configuration. Lab results cover the declared channels, not every file read,
external transfer or model request. Existing
[Kimi](docs/reports/test-report-kimi-guard-lab.md) and
[DSH](docs/reports/test-report-dsh-guard-lab.md) reports retain their bounded
results, failures and review states.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · guard-lab: test with evidence：Since RC3, the package includes [blue-team research](docs/research/README.md), a
[sanitized experiment report](docs/reports/blue-team-lab-2026-10.md) and a
[portable four-control example](docs/lab/blue-team-calibration.md).
The research covers provenance, disclosure permissions and task utility in
bounded private experiments; those methods do not extend production hook
coverage. Lab proceeds gradually. Forks, PRs and independent defensive
reproductions are welcome; preserve failed and inconclusive results.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · guard-lab: test with evidence：From a checkout or package containing the example, run all four existing controls: ```sh blue_run="$(mktemp -d)" python3 docs/lab/examples/blue-team-calibration.py --output-dir "$blue_run/controls" ``` This example calls no model; its summary describes instrument calibration.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Recover a supported deletion：From the workspace being protected, point at your package/checkout root:

```sh
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/safe_delete.py src/old_module.py --dry-run
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/safe_delete.py src/old_module.py
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/restore.py list
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/restore.py '<txid>'

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Recover a supported deletion：Valuable targets are relocated with exact recovery paths in a manifest.
Provably regenerable, Git-ignored artifacts may be deleted directly.
Supported Git overwrites snapshot tracked state; hard-reset collisions with
untracked/ignored content are refused. Force restore preserves the current
occupant before replacement. Errors can leave partial work: inspect the
reported transaction IDs, filesystem and state before retrying.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Recover a supported deletion：Version 0.2.5 makes these results explicit:
quarantined data still occupies storage, GC is manual, and `ALLOW_NOOP`
does not certify unrecognized command effects. Local status does not prove
that a host loaded the guard. See [status and cleanup feedback](docs/guides/recovery-feedback.md).

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Recover a supported deletion：Advisory `check.py` and `safe_delete.py --dry-run` preserve command targets but
may write quarantine/audit metadata and a Git local exclude entry. Advisory
exit 0 is not permission to execute a BLOCK or ASK.
See the [policy and assessment contract](skills/delete-guard/references/policy.md).

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Recover a supported deletion：RC1 added quarantine control-path protection, excluded PURGED transactions
from active GC planning, and minimized restore/safe_delete audit fields.
Exact CLI/manifest recovery paths remain available. The original 0.2.4 package
lacks these changes; 0.2.4-hotfix.1 backports only quarantine control-path
protection. See the [RC notes](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.5-rc1.md).

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Check text before emission：The payload owner invokes the scanner and applies its decision.
For a text file:

```sh
python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/check_span.py --channel file-write --json < draft.md
python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/sanitize.py --channel file-write < draft.md
```

A complete synthetic credential example is generated at runtime:

```sh
python3 -c 'print("config: sk-proj-" + "AbCdEf0123456789GhIjKl")' |
  python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/sanitize.py --channel file-write
```

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Check text before emission：The expected output is `config: sk-<REDACTED>`. The checker returns a
decision and plan; it never rewrites the payload. Its exit 0 means
ALLOW/SANITIZE assessment, while the sanitizer's successful stdout is the
allowed or rewritten text. ASK/BLOCK/error withholds sanitizer payload output.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Check text before emission：Detection covers documented credential shapes, value-free secret references
and selected host paths. It is not a general repository scanner or protection
against deliberate obfuscation. The text CLIs do not automatically append
egress audit events; a trusted integration owns emission and any audit storage.
For configuration inspection, an explicit safe view reports supported
JSON/dotenv structure without scalar values; it is not an editable copy or
automatic read interception.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Check text before emission：Read the [Skill](skills/exfil-guard/SKILL.md), [rules and exemption diagnostics](skills/exfil-guard/references/rules.md), and [channel contract](skills/exfil-guard/references/channels.md).

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Connect your coding agent：Ask the host's official coding agent to configure Agent Guard for the installed
version, following the [integration guide](adapters/INTEGRATION.md). Prefer a
hook that can block a tool call before it runs. We maintain the DSH and Kimi
Code integrations; other hosts use local bridges and configuration.

The results below apply to the recorded source versions, host versions and
tool paths. Other combinations need their own checks.

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Connect your coding agent：Use the [full capability and evidence matrix](docs/guides/harness-capabilities.md)
for precise versions, tests and gaps. `doctor.py kimi|claude --probe` checks a
selected configuration and local adapter path; PASS does not prove a live
host loaded the hook. Drift checks are local preflight. A live sentinel is
explicit, may consume provider quota, and covers only its sampled root Bash
call. See the [host drift guide](docs/guides/host-drift.md).

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · Decisions, recovery and documentation：The shared protocol is `ALLOW · SANITIZE · RELOCATE · SNAPSHOT · ASK · BLOCK`,
with stable reason codes and explanations.
Aggregation is `BLOCK > ASK > RELOCATE/SNAPSHOT > SANITIZE > ALLOW`.
Opaque targets and protected boundaries are refused; supported recoverable
mutations compensate before proceeding. Authorization state remains a local
discipline, not an isolated identity boundary.

**让 AI Agent 的破坏性操作默认可逆。** · [English](README.md)

Agent Guard 在受支持的删除、覆盖操作前保留恢复数据，检查待外发文本中的
敏感信息，并提供 Lab 来测试 Agent 和宿主的实际行为。共享 Python Core
可通过命令行工具或宿主适配器调用。

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · AGENT-GUARD：**负责接入本项目的 AI agent：** 修改配置或编写桥接前，必须先读取
[适配要求](adapters/INTEGRATION.md)，再阅读
[接入流程](docs/guides/getting-started.md#set-up-a-coding-agent)和对应适配器指南。
确认实际宿主／版本，查阅其官方 hook 文档，完成验证后报告实际覆盖范围。
不能仅凭 Skill 已安装或配置已复制，就告诉用户防护已生效。

目前主要维护 **DSH 和 Kimi Code** 的接入。其他宿主建议交给对应的官方
编码 Agent 在本地配置。

| **清理提议（0.2.7）** | 扫描候选、分类、大小与实际执行方式；显式选择并确认后交给 safe_delete | [Cleanup Copilot](docs/guides/cleanup-plan.md) |
| **删除限制（0.2.7）** | 查询共享保护路径、持久预算、速率／重复限制与大批量确认 | [限制与恢复](docs/guides/deletion-limits.md) |
| **本地 MCP 工具（0.2.7）** | 在支持的客户端中调用 safe_delete、普通恢复、事务／状态查询和 GC 预览 | [MCP 接入](docs/guides/mcp.md) |
| **外发检测** | 检测受支持的凭据和本机标识路径；应用脱敏计划或拒绝输出 | [exfil-guard](skills/exfil-guard/SKILL.md) |
| **行为验测** | 校准观察器，验证声明信道的暴露，再比较匹配的关闭／开启防护试次 | [guard-lab](docs/lab/guard-lab.md) |

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · AGENT-GUARD：Skill 提供操作纪律，不会自行拦截工具调用。自动保护依赖宿主实际加载了 兼容 hook，且调用位于其覆盖范围内。Agent Guard 不是抵抗同权限恶意进程的 OS 沙箱；实际接入证据和缺口见[能力矩阵](docs/guides/harness-capabilities.md)。 可选本地 MCP 适配器提供显式工具，不会拦截绕过它的操作；其 SDK 单独安装， 不改变 Core 的运行依赖。

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · guard-lab：用证据验测行为：guard-lab 是**用户控制的实验工具**。它在一次性项目中放入非秘密合成标记和
无害诱饵，只观察明确声明的信道。真正的控制器与证据保存在交给受测 Agent 的
夹具之外。

流程分别回答三个问题：

1. **校准**：观察器、标记、扫描和证据链是否正常？内建对照不调用模型，
   不访问外网。
2. **观察暴露**：关闭防护的真实宿主试次是否触发了选定信道？
3. **比较防护**：有效基线成立后，匹配的开启防护试次是否减少或阻止了该暴露？

在安装包或源码根目录，从一项零模型对照开始：

```sh
lab_run="$(mktemp -d)"
python3 guard_lab.py run --case clean --output-dir "$lab_run/clean" --json
```

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · guard-lab：用证据验测行为：另三项对照是 `mock-positive`、`mock-injection` 和 `snapshot-positive`。
真实宿主实验前应按 [Lab 指南](docs/lab/guard-lab.md)跑齐四项对照；
安装包也提供 `agent-guard-lab` 命令。

对照 PASS 只表示**仪器校准**，不表示模型安全。观察器不健康或证据缺失时为
`INCONCLUSIVE`；未防护基线安静，不能证明防护有效。配对比较需要匹配相关的
harness／版本／模型、任务、协议及非防护配置。结果只覆盖声明信道，不能扩展
到所有文件读取、外网传输或模型请求。已有
[Kimi](docs/reports/test-report-kimi-guard-lab.md) 与
[DSH](docs/reports/test-report-dsh-guard-lab.md) 报告保留各自的有限结论、
失败和待审状态。

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · guard-lab：用证据验测行为：自 RC3 起，包中包含[蓝队研究](docs/research/README.md)、
[去敏实验报告](docs/reports/blue-team-lab-2026-10.md)和
[便携四控制示例](docs/lab/blue-team-calibration.md)，公开来源、发送授权和正常任务效用的
有界研究。私有装配中的验证不扩展生产 hook 覆盖。Lab 将缓慢、小规模推进，欢迎 fork、PR
与独立防守复现；失败和未定结果也应保留。

在包含该示例的源码或包根目录，可一次运行现有四种控制：

```sh
blue_run="$(mktemp -d)"
python3 docs/lab/examples/blue-team-calibration.py --output-dir "$blue_run/controls"
```

示例不调用模型，摘要只用于仪器校准。

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · 恢复一次受支持的删除：有价值的目标迁入隔离区，manifest 保留准确恢复路径。可证明能够再生成且被
Git 忽略的产物可直接删除。受支持的 Git 覆盖操作先快照 tracked 状态；
hard reset 与 untracked／ignored 内容发生碰撞时拒绝执行。force restore
先保全当前占位版本，再恢复旧版本。错误可能留下部分操作，应先核查返回的
事务 ID、现场文件和状态，再决定后续动作。

0.2.5 明确提示：迁入回收站的数据仍占空间，
GC 需要显式执行，`ALLOW_NOOP` 不代表未识别命令没有破坏性。
本地状态查询也不能证明宿主已加载防护。见[状态与清理反馈](docs/guides/recovery-feedback.md)。

隔离区／审计元数据及 Git 本地 exclude。advisory 退出码 0 不代表 BLOCK／ASK
操作获准执行。详见[策略与评估契约](skills/delete-guard/references/policy.md)。

RC1 已增加隔离区控制路径保护、从活跃 GC 计划排除 PURGED 事务，并最小化

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · 外发前检查文本：持有载荷的调用方主动运行扫描器，并按判决处理文本：

```sh
python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/check_span.py --channel file-write --json < draft.md
python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/sanitize.py --channel file-write < draft.md
```

在运行时生成完整的合成凭据示例：

```sh
python3 -c 'print("config: sk-proj-" + "AbCdEf0123456789GhIjKl")' |
  python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/sanitize.py --channel file-write
```

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · 外发前检查文本：预期输出是 `config: sk-<REDACTED>`。检查器返回判决和计划，不改写载荷；
其退出码 0 表示 ALLOW／SANITIZE 评估成功，sanitizer 成功输出的 stdout 才是
允许或已改写的文本。ASK／BLOCK／错误时 sanitizer 不输出载荷。

检测覆盖文档列明的凭据形状、无需读值的秘密引用和特定本机路径。它不是通用
仓库扫描器，也不能抵抗刻意编码绕过。文本 CLI 不自动追加外发审计；
可信接入方负责实际外发和需要的审计存储。检查配置时，可用显式安全视图查看
支持的 JSON／dotenv 结构及状态；它不是可编辑副本，也不自动拦截普通读取。

详见 [Skill](skills/exfil-guard/SKILL.md)、
[规则与豁免诊断](skills/exfil-guard/references/rules.md)、
[信道契约](skills/exfil-guard/references/channels.md)。

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · 接入你的编码 Agent：让对应宿主的官方编码 Agent 按[适配指南](adapters/INTEGRATION.md)，为当前
安装的版本配置 Agent Guard。优先使用能在工具执行前阻止调用的 hook。
我们主要维护 DSH 和 Kimi Code 的接入；其他宿主由 Agent 在本地配置桥接。

下表记录所测源码、宿主版本和工具路径；其他组合需要另行验证。

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · 接入你的编码 Agent：| 宿主 | 接入与证据 |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | 保留参考实现，暂缓新版本验收。Bash 原生 `PreToolUse`；2.1.270／2.1.273 的受限脚本宿主拦截记录。[接入](adapters/claude/README.md) |
| Kimi Code | Bash 原生 `PreToolUse`；0.42.0 的有限主／子路径及 2.1.1 的根代理 Bash 记录。0.2.6 新增 2.3.0 prompt／ACP 根代理 Bash 固定响应证据。ASK 拒绝；缺失／超时 hook 不覆盖。[接入](adapters/kimi-code/README.md) |
| DSH | 默认删除适配覆盖 0.1.5-rc.1／0.2.0-rc.2／0.2.1-alpha.4。可选原生 read 与 Lab 保留各自的两版边界。[兼容范围](docs/design/dsh-compatibility.md) · [接入](adapters/dsh/README.md) |
| Codex／其他宿主 | 推荐官方 Agent 按当前版本完成本地 hook 接入，并验证确实阻止执行。没有阻塞 hook 时，Skill／CLI 仍属于协作式使用。[适配指南](adapters/INTEGRATION.md) |

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · 接入你的编码 Agent：精确版本、试验与缺口统一见[完整能力矩阵](docs/guides/harness-capabilities.md)。
`doctor.py kimi|claude --probe` 只检查选定配置和本地适配路径；PASS 不证明
真实宿主已加载 hook。漂移检查也是本地预检。live sentinel 为显式操作，
可能消耗模型额度，只覆盖该次根代理 Bash 调用，见
[宿主漂移指南](docs/guides/host-drift.md)。

@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard README · 决策、事故恢复与文档：共享协议是 `ALLOW · SANITIZE · RELOCATE · SNAPSHOT · ASK · BLOCK`，
附带稳定 reason code 和说明。
聚合优先级为 `BLOCK > ASK > RELOCATE/SNAPSHOT > SANITIZE > ALLOW`。
不透明目标和保护边界拒绝执行；受支持的可恢复修改先补偿再继续。
授权状态属于本地操作纪律，不是隔离的身份边界。

事故后，[recovery-audit](skills/recovery-audit/SKILL.md)帮助依据尚存的
Git／会话／缓存证据恢复项目，区分原文、重建与确认缺失；没有来源保留的字节
无法凭空恢复。
